base_chance_by_standard_and_band.bands_note: columns are Short, Medium, Long, Extreme (printed 8-12)
base_chance_by_standard_and_band.scaling_note: the final modifier total is multiplied by 5% at Short/Medium and 3% at Long/Extreme, then added to the base chance

damage_multipliers_barrels_by_band.eleven_four_binding: Size Class A-D land structures multiply the Annex C band damage; Size Class E and smaller take one single hit regardless of the number of guns (printed 11.4/PDF116)
damage_multipliers_barrels_by_band.barrel_counts_are_not_printed: Annex C carries no barrel counts; service.barrels is an explicit scenario declaration and rounds above 12 are outside the printed rows

implemented_in_engine.ship_spotting_shifts: producer ground2026::source_spotting (+1 ship 3rd turn, +2 aerial/ground 2nd turn, +3 beacon, -4 map, -6 blind, multi-spotter penalty); first/second-turn penalty VALUES unprinted, not applied
implemented_in_engine.land_overconcentration: 11.4/PDF117: -2*(N-1) for EACH firing ship. Allocate all actual targets first; canonical whole-window count replaces the historical spotting helper recent-ship term instead of doubling it.
implemented_in_engine.necessary_inputs_pending: visibility percent, sea state and under-fire state must be declared/observed; an unknown input pends the die instead of an implicit zero
implemented_in_engine.land_target_no_radar_gfc_ignore: a land NGFS target has no beacon/radar-GFC wording, so visibility modifiers are never ignored
implemented_in_engine.kyds_note: printed 8-11 example: 7800 yd short range is almost four nautical miles
implemented_in_engine.sea_state_columns: FIRING SHIP size A-B/C-D/E-G, never number of barrels; missing necessary source/author size at sea state >=3 pends the die; numeric penalties and NFP are consumed.
implemented_in_engine.barrel_hit_modifier: 1-2:+0, 3-4:+1, 5-6:+2, 7-8:+3, 9-10:+4; 11-12 unprinted => pending hit modifier, not inferred from the separate damage multiplier.

unimplemented_pending_no_invention.land_within_45deg_inside_fcr_range: printed -1; engine has no verified land geometry, not applied
unimplemented_pending_no_invention.structure_aspect_columns: no land binding printed; no modifier applied on top of stationary
unimplemented_pending_no_invention.dead_reckoning_blind_twilight_illuminati: printed values exist but engine inputs (visual loss turn, muzzle flash, starshell) are not bound; not applied
unimplemented_pending_no_invention.ship_spotting_first_two_turns_penalty: wording printed, values not printed; not applied

cn_pj45a.name: PRC PJ-45A 130mm/70
cn_pj45a.source: China's Navy 1 Dec 25, Annex C - Naval Guns C-1 (PDF68 row visually verified 2026-10-28)
cn_pj45a.penetration_note: Short/Medium print belt (vertical) penetration; Long/Extreme print the belt/deck pair; each value is checked against its own armor face
cn_pj45a.barrels_note: not printed in Annex C; service.barrels must be declared by the scenario

eleven_four_scope.self_spotted_destruction_fire: Short/Medium and less than 10 kyds; aerial/observer spotting reaches Extreme (printed 11.4)
eleven_four_scope.one_ship_per_target: destruction fire precision restricts shooters to one ship per target (printed 11.4/PDF117)
eleven_four_scope.reverse_hit: 11.6/11.7 whole-complex bombardment rolls ground2026::bombardment_target before resolution; empty space is an automatic miss
eleven_four_scope.nonpenetration: 11.4 checks structure penetration without printing a land non-penetration damage rule; the engine records 11.4.nonpenetration_pending and applies no damage instead of borrowing the missile half-damage rule
eleven_four_scope.neutralization: Map/Blind remain source spotting producers; destructive DP execution is rejected until area and neutralization effects are separately qualified.

wiring.state: rules.ground.ngfs: services, jobs, resolutions, fired, diagnostics
wiring.phases: Collect declarations, arbitrate conflicts and count all actually committed ships against their declared target before reverse-hit location, including empty/pending reverse outcomes. Component DP then uses one common LandHit.
wiring.weapons_entry: weapons.rs Base-target Gun branch calls ngfs::prepare_from_fire; unregistered guns keep the registered NOT_BOUND rejection
wiring.own_view: Pure own queued-order helper only; referee resolutions are not side observations. Full own entity observation attachment remains pending.
wiring.d100_arithmetic: Existing ULP-aware threshold comparator, no rule rounding: an original D10090 at printed90% hits.

shared_ship_gun_contract.source_distinction: Existing RTS atomic-intent conversion, not a printed firing-rate or probability rule
shared_ship_gun_contract.cadence: one declared ship-gun Tactical Turn slot shared by surface and NGFS
shared_ship_gun_contract.conflict: same-phase surface/NGFS target conflicts reject before either debit, independent of command/provider order
shared_ship_gun_contract.physical_stock: when explicit shells-per-attack tracking is enabled, debit actual aggregate and declared physical stock together
